incidents.title: Three tankers hit naval mines in Strait of Hormuz, Iran state TV says – AP
incidents.description: Three oil tankers caught fire overnight and early on Monday after hitting naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz, the Associated Press reported, citing Iranian state television. Statements from Iran’s paramilitary Revolutionary Guard Corps and the army warned shipping companies that a U.S.-protected path through the strait remains dangerous due to the mines. The report ...
